_grade: [L] LOCKED external input. These are ordinal FIRST-APPEARANCE Carnegie stages of human embryonic primordia, compiled from standard human-embryology references. They are NEVER adjusted to change a correlation. The calibration in dev_timing.py treats this table as read-only and tests corr(DNA-derived schedule, observed stage); the table does not depend on gamma in any way.
_provenance: Ordinal first-appearance Carnegie stages (CS) compiled from standard references: O'Rahilly R & Muller F, 'Developmental Stages in Human Embryos' (Carnegie Inst. of Washington, Publ. 637, 1987; 2nd ed. 2010); Larsen's Human Embryology (Schoenwolf et al.); UNSW Embryology (Hill MA). These are canonical, textbook-stable ORDINAL stages. Exact day estimates are contextual only and are NOT used in the rank-correlation test.
_method: Each external/sensory primordium below is tagged with the SAME master gene used in feature_atlas_plus, restricted to [V] genuine masters only (so the timing test is not confounded by representative [F] tags). The model's emergence schedule for these features is argsort(spinodal(gamma)) -- a pure readout of MEASURED gamma. The test reports Spearman rho and Pearson r between the gamma-derived schedule and the observed CS, plus an exact permutation p-value. RANK correlation is used so the result is robust to +/-1-stage encoding uncertainty.
_scope_note: Only [V] masters are included: eye=PAX6, ear/otic=PAX2, nose/olfactory=LHX2, forelimb=TBX5, hindlimb=TBX4, digits=HOXD13, tooth=PAX9. Representative [F] tags (cranium=FOXG1, jaw=SHH, cheek=MYOD1, lips=POU2F3, hair=EDAR, etc.) are deliberately EXCLUDED from the timing test because a weak gene->feature link would confound a timing claim. Including more clean [V] masters (with documented staging) would tighten the test.
_frozen: This table is content-frozen; verify_dev_timing.py check #2 pins its sha256 and asserts the stages are integers independent of the gamma table (not back-fitted).
